description: This Java abstract class defines a data access object (DAO) for handling time series data with chunked aggregation capabilities, including initialization, cleanup, data removal, querying, and aggregation switching logic.

classes.name: AbstractChunkedAggregationTimeseriesDao
classes.description: An abstract DAO class for chunked aggregation time series data, managing initialization, cleanup, data removal, querying, and aggregation logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the blocking queue with parameters and comparator for batching and sorting.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources by destroying the queue.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes time series data based on tenant, entity, and delete query.

methods.name: savePartition
methods.description: Stub method for saving data partition, currently returns immediate future with null.

methods.name: findAllAsync
methods.description: Processes a single query asynchronously, handling aggregation and interval logic.

methods.name: findAllWithLimit
methods.description: Retrieves limited time series data with sorting.

methods.name: findAndAggregateAsync
methods.description: Performs asynchronous aggregation over a time interval.

methods.name: switchAggregation
methods.description: Switches between different aggregation types and retrieves corresponding data.
